title: Task spec v1
description: What a builder is asked to do: a goal, the repo it applies to, an optional branch, and the grant that bounds it (embedded or by reference).

repo.description: Repo identity as host/owner/name, for example github.com/KosherKev/agent-core. Host is a DNS-style hostname; owner and name are 1 to 100 of letters, digits, _ - and .; a segment of . or .., a name ending in .git (any case), empty segments, whitespace, backslashes, percent signs, control characters and non-ASCII are rejected.

grant_ref.description: The task_id of a grant held elsewhere.
